changelog: - **A share link that cannot be opened no longer stays in the address bar or holds back the first-run Welcome card.** A link whose diagram passed the file checks but could not be placed on the canvas — one saved by an older version with a node entry that has no data — made the loader stop with an error: the link stayed in the address bar, so every reload tried it again, and the Welcome card that waits for the boot to settle never appeared. The placement now runs with the other checks, before the replace question and before anything changes, so such a link is reported like any other unreadable one: your current diagram, a run in progress and the Monte Carlo settings stay as they were, the link is removed from the address bar, and the app settles. A protected link with the same problem ends in its "not a diagram" notice instead of a password dialog left busy. Should a load fail after it has begun, that is reported as its own case, not as a bad link: the run was stopped and the canvas may show part of the diagram, and a reload returns to the last saved one — a protected link says so in a notice of its own.
